title: Model repeats a recalled key in its final prose reply (no hook can prevent it)
reason_not_testable: No tool runs, so PreToolUse and PostToolUse never fire on the model's final prose. Per the hooks docs cited in the catalog, Stop receives last_assistant_message only after the reply is produced, and MessageDisplay changes only displayed text while the transcript keeps the original. Prevention is not hookable; only Stop-time detection could be asserted, and that is not a fixture kind. Non-hook control: rotate any key that appears in output and add a Stop-hook detector that alerts without claiming prevention.
